learning_objectives: Distinguish normally-open and changeover relay operation.
Measure coil resistance and verify contact switching.
steps: Identify the relay diagram printed on its case.
With power disconnected, inspect coil and contact continuity.
Energize the coil only with a fused, current-limited supply of rated voltage.
Verify contact state changes and observe polarity if a suppression diode is fitted.
safety_notes: Use a fuse close to the supply.
Never infer terminal function from physical position; follow relay diagram.
Use appropriately rated load and wiring; avoid mains voltage.
